title: Databricks Architect
description:
Databricks Architect / Senior Data Engineer (Contract)

Location: Brazil (Remote – supporting US-based clients)

Contract Length: 6 months


Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Databricks Architect who remains highly hands-on as a Data Engineer to support data platform design and delivery for US-based clients. This role will focus on building and optimizing modern lakehouse solutions, with strong ownership of architecture decisions while actively contributing to development.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and evolve Databricks lakehouse solutions , following medallion architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold) best practices
  • Act as the technical architect while remaining hands-on in pipeline development , optimization, and troubleshooting
  • Build and maintain scalable data pipelines using Databricks, Spark, and SQL
  • Collaborate with US-based stakeholders, architects, and delivery teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions
  • Optimize performance, cost, and reliability across data workloads
  • Contribute to data modeling, data quality, and governance practices
  • Leverage recent exposure to Microsoft Fabric where appropriate, understanding how it complements or integrates with Databricks-based architectures


Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong experience as a Databricks Architect and/or Senior Data Engineer
  • Proven, hands-on experience implementing medallion architecture in production environments
  • Advanced knowledge of Apache Spark , Databricks , and SQL
  • Experience designing end-to-end data pipelines and lakehouse architectures
  • Recent exposure to Microsoft Fabric (hands-on preferred)
  • Ability to balance architecture leadership with hands-on engineering work
  • Strong English language skills and experience working with US-based clients or teams


Nice to Have

  • Experience in consulting or professional services environments
  • Familiarity with data governance, security, and cost optimization in cloud platforms
  • Experience working in hybrid Databricks / Fabric ecosystems

description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.

From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months

If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.


About SpendHound:

  • SpendHound is a 100% free software renewal management platform and service recently launched by the research firm YipitData. (See this introductory video from SpendHound’s Senior Product Manager!)

  • A comprehensive view of all software applications used with annual contract values, auto-renewal information, renewal dates, license counts, and more
  • An invoice and contract management system for companies to store their invoices and contracts
  • Renewal reminders through email and Slack so companies never miss upcoming software renewals
  • Free advice from procurement experts to discuss price benchmarking insights and negotiation strategies for any upcoming renewals
  • Companies use the SpendHound platform and procurement expert service to save time and money on their software renewals.

Are you a collaborative consulting, analytics, or operations professional with 3+ years of experience, passionate about building a world-class revenue team?

We are seeking a Revenue Operations Associate to play a crucial role in our fast-growing team, SpendHound. As a fast-growing “start-up” within a larger organization, this is a unique opportunity for someone with a strong operational mindset to come in and help build something truly special.

  • Your experience with CRMs such as Salesforce.com
  • You are willing to become proficient in SQL and data management
  • You are a natural problem-solver, with a keen eye for detail and spotting issues

What We Offer:

  • Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)

  • Personal laptop

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Job Description

About You

You are a Senior Data Engineer who enjoys building reliable, scalable data platforms and enabling data-driven and AI-powered products. You feel comfortable owning data pipelines end to end, working closely with analytics and AI/Data Science teams, and translating complex data problems into robust technical solutions.

You value clean architecture, performance, and data quality, and you’re curious about AI/ML integrations even if you’re not a model builder. You thrive in collaborative environments and can operate with autonomy while guiding best practices across teams.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field — or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience as a Data Engineer, building and operating production-grade data pipelines.
  • Strong expertise in SQL, including advanced joins, CTEs, window functions, and performance tuning.
  • Experience designing data models and analytical structures (dimensional models, facts, dimensions, SCDs).
  • Hands-on experience building ETL/ELT pipelines using modern orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster, DBT, or similar).
  • Proficiency in Python for data processing and pipeline development (PySpark is a strong plus).
  • Solid experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) for data storage and processing.
  • Familiarity with data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, PostgreSQL, or similar.
  • Experience using Git and CI/CD practices as part of a modern data engineering workflow.
  • Exposure to supporting AI/Data Science initiatives, such as data enablement for models, embeddings, entity matching, or advanced analytics (nice to have).
  • Familiarity with graph databases, embeddings, or AI integrations from a data engineering perspective (nice to have).
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with analysts, ML engineers, and product teams.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2+), able to work with global stakeholders.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ingestion processes supporting analytics and AI use cases.
  • Implement and optimize ETL/ELT workflows with attention to performance, reliability, and cost.
  • Design and evolve data models and curated layers to support reporting, analytics, and downstream systems.
  • Collaborate with analytics, AI/Data Science, and product teams to understand data requirements and SLAs.

title: Desenvolvedor Back End SR
description:
Desenvolvedor Back End - atuação internacional


Descrição:

A Genesis Consulting tem oportunidade imediata para Desenvolvedores experientes com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e entrega de valor através da tecnologia. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades.


Atuação:

Como desenvolvedor de software você será responsável por projetar, codificar, testar e executar aplicativos de software construídos com arquitetura de microsserviços, que se comunicam por meio de APIs e são hospedados na AWS. Esses aplicativos possibilitam experiências digitais inovadoras e baseadas em dados que melhoram a eficácia operacional de um dos maiores players Globais no seguimento. Você trabalhará como parte de uma equipe ágil, com consultores de várias localidades do globo, empregando as melhores práticas em desenvolvimento, segurança e design.


Perfil técnico:

  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência como engenheiro de software
  • B.Sc. em ciência da computação, engenharia elétrica ou equivalente
  • Pelo menos 2 anos de experiência em Python
  • Experiência com Golang é uma vantagem
  • Experiência prática no desenvolvimento de frameworks de serviços distribuídos
  • Experiência prática com bancos de dados distribuídos, como RDS/Aurora/PostgreSQL, Redshift, DynamoDB, Redis, MongoDB, etc.
  • Experiência prática no uso de tecnologias de correio de mensagens, como SNS/SQS, Kafka, RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ, etc.
  • Pelo menos 2 anos de experiência com a AWS
  • Experiência com CDK é uma vantagem
  • Experiência com arquitetura de Microsserviços, Docker e Kubernetes
  • Experiência na construção de pipelines CI/CD usando Terraform (preferencial) ou Azure DevOps


Mandatório:

  • Bacharelado em Ciências da Computação ou similar;
  • Inglês fluente

title: Senior Visual Designer
description:
What is Teachable?

Teachable is the platform for experts and businesses who take education seriously. In a world where anyone can ask AI for information, we're the home for those who educate with purpose, modernity, and humanity. We help experts and businesses scale their impact and operations through courses, coaching, and digital downloads that students actually love. From a finance expert teaching Python for investment analysis to a multilingual coach offering business Spanish for executives, Teachable powers human-led learning that drives student trust, connection, and results. With a sleek, intuitive interface and AI as a time-saving partner, the platform enables transformative education rooted in real-world experience. Teachable experts have lived it—that's why they teach it.Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey?

Part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators, experts, and businesses earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to cement itself as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize student outcomes, business growth, and flexibility. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of real-world learning to shape the future, we want you on our team!


About your team


Our Brand & Content team is a group of social media experts, newsletter writers, designers, copywriters, and event pros—all working together to build a world-class brand creators love. We focus on growing Teachable’s reach, connecting with new and existing audiences, and using content, design, and in-person experiences to drive awareness, generate leads, and deepen engagement.


What is the role?


We’re looking for a highly creative, results-oriented Brand Designer to join our Brand + Content Team. This role is for a strategic thinker with strong design execution skills and a deep understanding of brand systems. You’ll help shape and scale our visual storytelling, building cohesive brand expressions that drive engagement and recognition across campaigns, events, and experiences.

This role focuses on evolving and extending visual identity systems and applying brand guidelines across digital and physical touchpoints. You’ll design multi-channel marketing assets spanning email, paid media, social, web, and print, with an eye for consistency and craft. The ideal candidate also brings strengths in web and motion design to support a multidisciplinary team.

While an individual contributor role, you’ll collaborate closely with other designers—offering thoughtful critique, feedback, and informal mentorship—and partner cross-functionally to create design that resonates with our audience and reinforces our brand story.


In this role, you will:


  • Build upon and evolve brand guidelines by establishing sophisticated visual systems that align with business goals.
  • Proactively propose solutions to help improve project outcomes across a range of project types, including marketing and product.
  • Conceptualize and execute high-impact design across diverse formats: digital & print, event identities, promotional assets, and marketing materials that extend the Teachable brand.
  • Demonstrate versatility in applying design thinking to varied channels while maintaining cohesion across all output.
  • Foster a collaborative environment and work closely with stakeholders and cross-functional stakeholders including web, product marketing, growth, and events—to ensure creative execution aligns with GTM strategy, brand objectives, and campaign goals.
  • Provide mentorship to junior designers on the team.
  • Present creative concepts to teams across the organization in a clear and compelling manner.
  • Strive to maintain the brand standard across all projects and ensure consistency.
  • Manage end-to-end production for creative deliverables, including preparing files for presentations, cross functional partners, print vendors, and event production.
  • Build trusted relationships with cross-functional peers through clear communication, curiosity, and accountability.
  • Contribute motion design and animation to campaigns, launches, or brand moments that deepen storytelling and audience engagement.
  • Stay up to date on design trends and tools, with a particular focus on leveraging AI in design workflows


What you’ll bring:


  • Experience: 5+ years of visual design experience, with a strong focus on branding and performance marketing
  • Experience working collaboratively alongside fellow designers and/or offering mentorship/coaching to other designers
  • Skills: Excels in the Adobe Creative Suite and Figma
  • Portfolio: A strong portfolio showcasing a diverse range of design projects and assets (including email, social, paid advertising, print, etc.) , plus motion design
  • Strong design sensibility with attention to detail, typography, and visual storytelling.
  • Ability to adapt to brand guidelines while pushing creative boundaries; experience refining and scaling brand guidelines.
  • Strong collaboration skills and ability to work cross-functionally with marketers, designers, and content creators.
  • Self-starter with excellent organizational and time-management skills.
  • Understanding: Demonstrated understanding of brand identities, digital marketing principles, website design best practices, and performance marketing metrics.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and presentation skills to effectively communicate design concepts to stakeholders and gather feedback.
  • Adaptability: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and adapt to changing priorities.


Nice to have:

  • Experience working in SaaS, edtech, or within the creator economy.
  • Familiarity with video editing tools (Premiere Pro, Final Cut, or similar).
  • Knowledge of current trends in motion design, animation, and paid and social media.


While Teachable maintains our NY office for local employees to use, we operate as a remote-first culture in order to give our employees added flexibility. In order to maintain connection and create a community beyond the screen, Teachable holds in-person events throughout the year, where employees and teams can come together for bonding, strategic alignment, goal-setting, and celebrations!

title: Senior Visual Designer
description:
What is Teachable?

Teachable is the platform for experts and businesses who take education seriously. In a world where anyone can ask AI for information, we're the home for those who educate with purpose, modernity, and humanity. We help experts and businesses scale their impact and operations through courses, coaching, and digital downloads that students actually love. From a finance expert teaching Python for investment analysis to a multilingual coach offering business Spanish for executives, Teachable powers human-led learning that drives student trust, connection, and results. With a sleek, intuitive interface and AI as a time-saving partner, the platform enables transformative education rooted in real-world experience. Teachable experts have lived it—that's why they teach it.Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey?

Part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators, experts, and businesses earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to cement itself as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize student outcomes, business growth, and flexibility. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of real-world learning to shape the future, we want you on our team!


About your team


Our Brand & Content team is a group of social media experts, newsletter writers, designers, copywriters, and event pros—all working together to build a world-class brand creators love. We focus on growing Teachable’s reach, connecting with new and existing audiences, and using content, design, and in-person experiences to drive awareness, generate leads, and deepen engagement.


What is the role?


We’re looking for a highly creative, results-oriented Brand Designer to join our Brand + Content Team. This role is for a strategic thinker with strong design execution skills and a deep understanding of brand systems. You’ll help shape and scale our visual storytelling, building cohesive brand expressions that drive engagement and recognition across campaigns, events, and experiences.

This role focuses on evolving and extending visual identity systems and applying brand guidelines across digital and physical touchpoints. You’ll design multi-channel marketing assets spanning email, paid media, social, web, and print, with an eye for consistency and craft. The ideal candidate also brings strengths in web and motion design to support a multidisciplinary team.

While an individual contributor role, you’ll collaborate closely with other designers—offering thoughtful critique, feedback, and informal mentorship—and partner cross-functionally to create design that resonates with our audience and reinforces our brand story.


In this role, you will:


  • Build upon and evolve brand guidelines by establishing sophisticated visual systems that align with business goals.
  • Proactively propose solutions to help improve project outcomes across a range of project types, including marketing and product.
  • Conceptualize and execute high-impact design across diverse formats: digital & print, event identities, promotional assets, and marketing materials that extend the Teachable brand.
  • Demonstrate versatility in applying design thinking to varied channels while maintaining cohesion across all output.
  • Foster a collaborative environment and work closely with stakeholders and cross-functional stakeholders including web, product marketing, growth, and events—to ensure creative execution aligns with GTM strategy, brand objectives, and campaign goals.
  • Provide mentorship to junior designers on the team.
  • Present creative concepts to teams across the organization in a clear and compelling manner.
  • Strive to maintain the brand standard across all projects and ensure consistency.
  • Manage end-to-end production for creative deliverables, including preparing files for presentations, cross functional partners, print vendors, and event production.
  • Build trusted relationships with cross-functional peers through clear communication, curiosity, and accountability.
  • Contribute motion design and animation to campaigns, launches, or brand moments that deepen storytelling and audience engagement.
  • Stay up to date on design trends and tools, with a particular focus on leveraging AI in design workflows


What you’ll bring:


  • Experience: 5+ years of visual design experience, with a strong focus on branding and performance marketing
  • Experience working collaboratively alongside fellow designers and/or offering mentorship/coaching to other designers
  • Skills: Excels in the Adobe Creative Suite and Figma
  • Portfolio: A strong portfolio showcasing a diverse range of design projects and assets (including email, social, paid advertising, print, etc.) , plus motion design
  • Strong design sensibility with attention to detail, typography, and visual storytelling.
  • Ability to adapt to brand guidelines while pushing creative boundaries; experience refining and scaling brand guidelines.
  • Strong collaboration skills and ability to work cross-functionally with marketers, designers, and content creators.
  • Self-starter with excellent organizational and time-management skills.
  • Understanding: Demonstrated understanding of brand identities, digital marketing principles, website design best practices, and performance marketing metrics.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and presentation skills to effectively communicate design concepts to stakeholders and gather feedback.
  • Adaptability: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and adapt to changing priorities.


Nice to have:

  • Experience working in SaaS, edtech, or within the creator economy.
  • Familiarity with video editing tools (Premiere Pro, Final Cut, or similar).
  • Knowledge of current trends in motion design, animation, and paid and social media.


While Teachable maintains our NY office for local employees to use, we operate as a remote-first culture in order to give our employees added flexibility. In order to maintain connection and create a community beyond the screen, Teachable holds in-person events throughout the year, where employees and teams can come together for bonding, strategic alignment, goal-setting, and celebrations!

title: Consultor Sênior de Valuation
description:
Junte-se a Forvis Mazars


Se você quer uma carreira repleta de oportunidades, desafios, crescimento contínuo e um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e inovador, venha para a Forvis Mazars.


Sobre Nós


Somos uma das 10 maiores empresas em prestação de serviços, reconhecidos pela nossa excelência e capacidade de fornecer uma experiência única aos nossos clientes e equipes. Acreditamos que o crescimento sustentável é alcançado através do investimento no desenvolvimento de nossos colaboradores e novas tecnologias.

Como uma empresa global mantemos alto nível de excelência garantindo uma experiência única através de qualificação, trabalho integrado, tecnologia e desenvolvimento contínuo de nosso time.


Sua Jornada Conosco


Aqui, você terá a chance de trabalhar com um time de alto nível atendendo clientes globais, construindo conexões valiosas e evoluindo suas habilidades e competências. Oferecemos programas de treinamento focados no seu crescimento e qualificação, programas de desenvolvimento & performance e um ambiente que promove a excelência e aprendizado. Além do trabalho, cuidamos do seu bem-estar, garantindo um ambiente acolhedor, cultivando a riqueza das relações interpessoais.


Sobre a área


A área de Valuation é fundamental para a análise e a verificação minuciosa de informações, com o objetivo de assegurar a tomada de decisões informadas em processos de transações comerciais, fusões, aquisições e outras movimentações estratégicas.



Responsabilidades e Atribuições


  • Conduzir avaliações de empresas, ativos e projetos, utilizando metodologias como Fluxo de Caixa Descontado (DCF), Múltiplos de Mercado, Transações Comparáveis e outros métodos aplicáveis.
  • Estruturar, revisar e validar modelos financeiros complexos, assegurando premissas coerentes, aderência às normas técnicas e consistência dos resultados.
  • Analisar demonstrativos financeiros, projeções, premissas operacionais e cenários, identificando riscos, sensibilidades e pontos críticos do valuation.
  • Elaborar e revisar relatórios técnicos de valuation, assegurando clareza, robustez técnica e linguagem adequada para investidores, sócios, auditorias e órgãos reguladores.
  • Atuar em projetos relacionados a M&A, reorganizações societárias, testes de impairment, fairness opinion e suporte a due diligence financeira.
  • Realizar interface direta com clientes, participando de reuniões para entendimento do negócio, alinhamento de premissas, apresentação de resultados e esclarecimento de questionamentos técnicos.
  • Acompanhar juniors e plenos, orientando tecnicamente, revisando entregas e garantindo o cumprimento de prazos e padrões de qualidade do escritório.
  • Apoiar gestores e sócios na gestão dos projetos, incluindo controle de cronograma, escopo, horas e priorização de demandas.
  • Manter-se atualizado quanto a práticas de mercado, normas contábeis (CPC/IFRS), tendências econômicas e financeiras, aplicando esse conhecimento aos projetos.


Requisitos e Qualificações


  • Formação completa em Contabilidade, Direito, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência em Valuation.
  • Vivência em projetos de M&A é um diferencial.
  • Excel intermediário/avançado.
  • Boa comunicação oral e escrita, com habilidade de lidar com múltiplos stakeholders.


Benefícios


  • Serviço de telemedicina;
  • Rede de academias;
  • Canal de apoio psicológico;
  • Convênio com o SESC;
  • Vale Refeição/Alimentação – flexibilidade para o seu dia a dia;
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Descontos e, incentivos educacionais em diversas instituições.

title: B2B Content Writer
description:
JoomPro is the first and only end-to-end cross-border B2B marketplace. It serves small, medium, and large businesses, handling orders of any size from start to finish. Today, JoomPro operates in Brazil and Mexico, with plans to expand into other markets.


JoomPro is one of the key businesses of Joom, an international tech-centric group of e-commerce companies founded in 2016 in Latvia. Joom Group also includes other businesses: Joom, a global cross-border marketplace; JoomPulse, an AI analytics tool for Mercado Livre sellers; and Onfy, a pharmaceutical marketplace in Germany. Joom Group has offices in Latvia, China, Portugal, Germany, and Brazil, with its headquarters in Lisbon, Portugal. We work as one international team, sharing knowledge and collaborating across countries, businesses and products.


We are looking for a proactive Content Writer to support our efforts in content expansion.


Responsibilities

  • Write short-form copy for paid media, email marketing, landing pages
  • Create long-form content: blog posts/articles/ebooks
  • Adapt messaging across channels while maintaining brand tone of voice
  • Apply SEO best practices with guidance


Requirements

  • Strong skills in copywriting and content marketing, with more than 4 years of relevant experience
  • Ability to switch between performance-driven copy and brand / educational long-form content
  • Excellent writing and editing skills
  • Experience with B2B marketing communications and content creation


Preferred

  • Good English proficiency
  • Experience working in a similar Brazilian e-commerce and/or marketplace-related company


We offer

  • Compensation package: base salary and bonuses
  • PJ employment with a possibility to move to CLT employment later
  • Collaboration with colleagues across Portugal, Brazil, Latvia and China, with opportunities for promotions


Before applying for the above position, please review our Candidate Privacy Notice here: By responding to the vacancy, you acknowledge that you have read our Privacy notice.*

title: B2B Content Writer
description:
JoomPro is the first and only end-to-end cross-border B2B marketplace. It serves small, medium, and large businesses, handling orders of any size from start to finish. Today, JoomPro operates in Brazil and Mexico, with plans to expand into other markets.


JoomPro is one of the key businesses of Joom, an international tech-centric group of e-commerce companies founded in 2016 in Latvia. Joom Group also includes other businesses: Joom, a global cross-border marketplace; JoomPulse, an AI analytics tool for Mercado Livre sellers; and Onfy, a pharmaceutical marketplace in Germany. Joom Group has offices in Latvia, China, Portugal, Germany, and Brazil, with its headquarters in Lisbon, Portugal. We work as one international team, sharing knowledge and collaborating across countries, businesses and products.


We are looking for a proactive Content Writer to support our efforts in content expansion.


Responsibilities

  • Write short-form copy for paid media, email marketing, landing pages
  • Create long-form content: blog posts/articles/ebooks
  • Adapt messaging across channels while maintaining brand tone of voice
  • Apply SEO best practices with guidance


Requirements

  • Strong skills in copywriting and content marketing, with more than 4 years of relevant experience
  • Ability to switch between performance-driven copy and brand / educational long-form content
  • Excellent writing and editing skills
  • Experience with B2B marketing communications and content creation


Preferred

  • Good English proficiency
  • Experience working in a similar Brazilian e-commerce and/or marketplace-related company


We offer

  • Compensation package: base salary and bonuses
  • PJ employment with a possibility to move to CLT employment later
  • Collaboration with colleagues across Portugal, Brazil, Latvia and China, with opportunities for promotions


Before applying for the above position, please review our Candidate Privacy Notice here: By responding to the vacancy, you acknowledge that you have read our Privacy notice.*

title: Analista de contabilidade sênior
description:
Sobre a Posição:


Buscamos um(a) Analista Contábil Sênior para atuar de forma estratégica na área de Controladoria , com forte interface com operações e áreas de negócio. Esta posição é responsável por garantir a integridade das informações contábeis relacionadas a estoques e ativos fixos , apoiando o fechamento mensal e assegurando conformidade com normas contábeis, políticas internas e controles corporativos.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Garantir a acuracidade contábil dos estoques por meio de análises, conciliações, fechamento e reporte das contas.
  • Analisar e acompanhar contas transitórias de ativo fixo, assegurando correta classificação, capitalização e aderência às políticas contábeis.
  • Atuar no processo de capitalização de ativos fixos, incluindo controle e acompanhamento de autorizações de investimento.
  • Planejar, executar e acompanhar inventários físicos de estoques e ativos fixos, garantindo alinhamento entre registros físicos e contábeis.
  • Apoiar a análise de gastos, avaliando a correta classificação entre despesas e ativo imobilizado.
  • Analisar, reportar e discutir variações de inventário junto à liderança da área, contribuindo com análises críticas e recomendações.
  • Atuar em parceria com unidades operacionais e áreas de negócio, apoiando trâmites internos, controles e processos fiscais.
  • Assegurar o cumprimento dos procedimentos de Controladoria, controles internos e boas práticas contábeis, contribuindo para a melhoria contínua dos processos.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Formação superior completa em Ciências Contábeis , com CRC ativo
  • Sólida experiência em contabilidade geral e contabilidade aplicada a operações
  • Vivência consistente com estoques, inventários, ativos fixos e fechamento contábil mensal
  • Conhecimento de ambientes operacionais e processos produtivos
  • Excel em nível intermediário a avançado


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em ambientes operacionais ou industriais de maior complexidade
  • Vivência em empresas de grande porte ou multinacionais
  • Perfil analítico, crítico, organizado e orientado a processos e controles

title: DEV PHP-Senior
description:
Oportunidade 100% Remoto e PJ


Estamos buscando desenvolvedores(as) de sistemas/aplicações Web, para colaborar na construção de aplicativos seguros, escaláveis e de alto desempenho. O profissional atuará no ciclo de desenvolvimento completo de projetos existentes e novos projetos, desde a sua conceituação (escopo, analise, entendimento), desenvolvimento, testes e implantação.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Projetar e desenvolver aplicativos Web eficientes, tanto para a execução no servidor como nos browsers, com possibilidades de instalação na nuvem;

  • Executar as atividades de todas as fases do ciclo do desenvolvimento e implantação dos aplicativos, usando metodologias ágeis;
  • Colaborar na definição da solução técnica aos requisitos de negócio, junto a área de produtos e junto aos clientes, implementando-a de forma eficiente e eficaz;
  • Criar códigos bem projetados, testáveis, eficientes, seguros e aderentes às necessidades de negócio e com a arquitetura de referência corporativa;
  • Desenvolver garantindo a qualidade e a manutenibilidade do código, zelando por sua documentação e projetando/executando testes unitários e de integração;
  • Atuar como referência técnica para o time de desenvolvimento, atuando como replicador de conhecimento e das boas práticas corporativas.
  • Proatividade, ética e senso de ownership para assumir responsabilidades, entregar resultados consistentes e colaborar ativamente para o sucesso do time e dos projetos.
  • Compromisso com a qualidade, garantindo entregas consistentes e sem retrabalho, avaliando alternativas para cada situação e mantendo altos padrões mesmo sob pressão ou prazos desafiadores.
  • Foco em resultados, garantindo entregas de alto impacto, superando desafios e agregando valor de forma consistente, mesmo em condições desafiadoras.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Graduação Completa em Engenharia de Software, Ciências da Computação, Engenharia (outras especialidades), Matemática ou Física;

  • Experiência avançada em desenvolvimento de aplicação Web (Web App) de alta performance;
  • Experiência avançada com PHP;
  • Experiência com frameworks de mercado (Laravel, Zend ou Symfony);
  • Experiência com HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, JQuery, JavaScript, ReactJS;
  • Experiência na aplicação de arquitetura para projetos PHP e \"design patterns\";
  • Experiência avançada em base de dados (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL e MongoDB);
  • Experiência com Github
  • Experiência com as seguintes aplicações KeyCloak, RabittMQ Docker, DBEaver, MailHog, entre outras
  • Experiência ambientes Linux / Apache
  • OOP, Web Services, APIs Restfull, XML, SOA;
  • Sistema de Filas/Mensagerias (RabbitMQ);
  • Serviços em Nuvem AWS, GCP e Azure;
  • Experiência com qualidade de codificação e boas práticas tais como: testes unitários.
  • Conhecimento/participação de processos ágeis de desenvolvimento com experiência em metodologia ágil Scrum, XP, Agile.
  • Protagonismo (autodidata, assumir desafios, engajado) e capacidade de trabalho em equipes auto gerenciáveis.
  • Uso de assistentes de IA para codificação (ex: SuperMaven, Copilot, Gemini, OpenIA, Vercel AI, Lhama, Claude);

Requisitos e qualificações:

Certificações nos ambientes, e tecnologias descritas anteriormente

  • Conhecimento de outras linguagens (Java, Python)
  • Certificações web, qualidade de código, metodologia ágeis, etc

title: SAP Coupa  Source to Pay
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for SAP Coupa - Source to Pay who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


\"Responsibilities for this role include:

Developer with knowledge Solutions Design for Coupa, Configuration, Documentation, Testing, and Delivery with intelligent automation (Scope includes work among SAP and non-SAP Systems and Applications)

Excellent technical & functional configuration knowledge and demonstrated proficiency for SAP Source to Pay, inclusive of Smart Contract Management, Spend Analytics, Guided Buying, and Collaborative Supply Chain & Procurement Materials Management, Materials Management (Direct and Indirect)

Participate in gathering and documenting overall business requirements. Support all formal documentation of implementation and provide relevant functional inputs to technical team.

Configure and implement Coupa solutions for source to pay processes. Should be able to perform global Coupa configuration, Approval Workflow, Custom field set up for transactions, Chart of account, PO forms, Catalog, Supplier, Item, User setup, Security Roles and Permission as per business requirement.

Experience in Coupa Configuration and data loads in Sourcing, Contracting, Purchasing, invoicing Master data(Supplier, Materials and Accounting data) and Catalog Management.

Experience with Coupa integration and mapping to legacy SAP systems for transactional and master data interface in source to pay.

Create functional specification documents that require development of WRICEF (Workflow Reports Interfaces Conversion Enhancement and Form) objects

Prepare test cases, validate deliverables, and support client testing and user acceptance testing (UAT).

Responsible for solving complex business problems by creating IT solutions in consultation with business partners, architects and other stakeholders\"


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Observability Engineer – PL/SR
description:
Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Observability Engineer – PL/SR para atuar no desenho, implementação e operação de soluções de observabilidade, garantindo visibilidade ponta a ponta dos ambientes, aplicações e serviços em arquiteturas híbridas e multicloud.

Irá atuar para um cliente sediado em Portugal


Responsabilidades

  • Projetar e manter pipelines de telemetria para logs, métricas e traces ;
  • Desenvolver e operar a infraestrutura responsável pela coleta, processamento e roteamento de dados de observabilidade;
  • Arquitetar, implementar e operar a plataforma de observabilidade baseada no Grafana Stack ;
  • Integrar soluções de observabilidade em ambientes híbridos e multicloud , suportando diferentes tipos de workloads;
  • Trabalhar com ambientes containerizados e orquestrados com Kubernetes ;
  • Integrar observabilidade aos pipelines de CI/CD e práticas GitOps ;
  • Atuar em conjunto com times de plataforma, SRE e desenvolvimento para evolução contínua das soluções.


Requisitos

  • Graduação em áreas de tecnologia;
  • Experiência com Kubernetes e ambientes containerizados;
  • Experiência com Grafana Stack (arquitetura, implementação e operação);
  • Conhecimento em pipelines de observabilidade (Logs, Metrics e Traces);
  • Experiência ou conhecimento em Azure ou GCP;
  • Familiaridade com CI/CD (GitHub Actions ou similares) e GitOps (Argo CD).
  • Disponibilidade para atuação remota o fuso horário de Portugal


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com OpenTelemetry;
  • Vivência em ambientes críticos e distribuídos;
  • Conhecimentos em SRE ou engenharia de confiabilidade.

title: Data Engineer - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:
We’re looking for a skilled Data Engineer with hands-on experience in Apache Airflow to join our data team. In this role, you’ll be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and workflows that support our analytics and data-driven products.

  • Develop , schedule, and monitor data pipelines using Apache Airflow.
  • Collaborate with data analysts, scientists, and engineering teams to ensure reliable data delivery.
  • Optimize ETL processes for performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Maintain and improve data architecture, ensuring data integrity and security.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve pipeline failures and performance bottlenecks.

What we are looking for:

  • A degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Economics, or a related field.
  • Curiosity: You are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You get involved in the entire value chain, which can include front-end, back-end, big data infrastructure, ML models…
  • Collaboration: Knowledge sharing is essential to you, and you actively contribute to spreading information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: You bring solutions, new ideas, and innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment.

What We Offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Engenheiro de dados
description:
O que você fará:

Projetar e desenvolver arquiteturas de dados que suportem indicadores estratégicos, metas e engajamento.

Construir e automatizar pipelines ETL/ELT integrando sistemas transacionais e analíticos.

Desenvolver e otimizar modelos de dados analíticos (Star Schema e Snowflake).

Escrever e otimizar SQL avançado (CTEs, funções de janela, ajuste de desempenho).

Implementar processamento e automação de dados usando Python.

Construir e manter plataformas de dados baseadas em nuvem na AWS

Trabalhar com Amazon S3, Redshift e/ou Athena para dar suporte ao armazenamento e análise de dados

Aplicar a qualidade, governança e linhagem dos dados em todos os conjuntos de dados

Colaborar com as partes interessadas do negócio para traduzir as necessidades do negócio em conjuntos de dados analíticos

Dar suporte a ferramentas de BI e análise, como Power BI, Tableau e Looker

Garantir a conformidade com os requisitos regulatórios e de governança em ambientes bancários e de fintech

Requisitos Mandatários:

Sólida experiência como engenheiro de dados.

Solida experiencia com SQL (CTEs, funções de janela, otimização de desempenho).

Experiência com modelagem analítica de dados.

Experiência prática na construção e automação de pipelines ETL/ELT.

Fortes habilidades em Python para processamento de dados e automação.

Sólida experiência com arquiteturas de dados em nuvem na AWS.

Experiência prática com Amazon S3 e Redshift e/ou Athena.

Experiência na integração de sistemas transacionais e analíticos.

Sólida experiência em armazenamento de dados e data lakes.

Experiência no uso do Git para controle de versão de código.

Sólido conhecimento de qualidade, governança e linhagem de dados.

Capacidade de traduzir requisitos de negócios em conjuntos de dados analíticos confiáveis.

Experiência com ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Tableau, Looker).

Experiência anterior em ambientes regulamentados (bancos, fintechs, LGPD).

Diferenciais:

Experiência com dbt.

Uso de ferramentas de orquestração, como Airflow, Prefect ou Dagster.

Conhecimento de AWS Glue. Experiencia com IA.

Familiaridade com Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform).

Conhecimento de arquiteturas Lakehouse ou Data Mesh.

Experiência com plataformas de streaming de dados (Kafka, Kinesis).

title: Ecommerce DTC Copywriter
description:
DTC Copywriter - Direct Response Facebook Ads (Remote - Brazil)

About the Role


We're looking for a DTC copywriter to write Facebook/Meta ad hooks and scripts for a fast-growing e-commerce brand doing $1M + . This is a hands-on writing role - you'll create ads that sell, not brand content.

This role is NOT for you if:


  • You don't have DTC/e-commerce experience
  • You've never written Facebook ads that drove sales
  • Your background is SEO, blogs, brand copywriting, or journalism
  • English is not fluent (written AND spoken)


What you'll do:


  • Write 2-3 Facebook ad scripts daily (hooks, angles, short-form video scripts)
  • Research customer pain points and develop new angles
  • Collaborate directly with the founder on creative strategy
  • Test and iterate based on performance data


Requirements:


  • 2+ years writing DTC/e-commerce Facebook ads
  • Proven ads that scaled (show us examples)
  • Fluent English - written AND spoken (all communication and copy is in English)
  • Available for weekly calls during EST business hours
  • Fast communicator - slow replies = not a fit


Compensation:


  • $4,000 USD/month base + performance bonus tied to ad results
  • Remote, flexible hours
  • Long-term role with growth potential

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
This position is fully remote and CLT model and salary range is 20k-28k BRL/mo.


Must‑haves:

  • 8+ years of professional experience as a Software Engineer, with strong emphasis on PHP
  • Minimum 1 year of lead development experience (technical leadership, guidance, oversight)
  • Strong PHP 7.x and 8.x background (ideally working with PHP in the most recent project) – Comfortable upgrading PHP versions and eliminating underlying vulnerabilities
  • Hands‑on experience with Node.js — updating underlying libraries and ensuring proper packaging
  • Experience with Docker containerization (application‑side responsibilities, not Kubernetes cluster management)


Day‑to‑Day:

In this role, you’ll lead a small engineering team (3–5 developers) while remaining hands‑on with PHP and Node.js development. You’ll help scope work, estimate story points, guide best practices, and ensure high‑quality delivery as the team modernizes and migrates legacy applications. This includes supporting a large‑scale infrastructure initiative to containerize and move roughly 40 legacy PHP applications onto a Kubernetes‑based platform. The work involves lift‑and‑shift migration with targeted refactoring—preserving the existing codebase, reducing redundancy across applications, containerizing services, and helping move source control into GitHub with updated CI/CD pipelines. You’ll partner closely with DevOps and infrastructure teams to ensure application standards and deployment requirements are met throughout the modernization effort.

  • 8+ years of professional experience as a Software Engineer, with strong emphasis on PHP
  • Minimum 1 year of lead development experience (technical leadership, guidance, oversight)
  • Strong PHP 7.x and 8.x background (ideally working with PHP in the most recent project) – Comfortable upgrading PHP versions and eliminating underlying vulnerabilities
  • Hands‑on experience with Node.js — updating underlying libraries and ensuring proper packaging
  • Experience with Docker containerization (application‑side responsibilities, not Kubernetes cluster management)


Day‑to‑Day:

In this role, you’ll lead a small engineering team (3–5 developers) while remaining hands‑on with PHP and Node.js development. You’ll help scope work, estimate story points, guide best practices, and ensure high‑quality delivery as the team modernizes and migrates legacy applications. This includes supporting a large‑scale infrastructure initiative to containerize and move roughly 40 legacy PHP applications onto a Kubernetes‑based platform. The work involves lift‑and‑shift migration with targeted refactoring—preserving the existing codebase, reducing redundancy across applications, containerizing services, and helping move source control into GitHub with updated CI/CD pipelines. You’ll partner closely with DevOps and infrastructure teams to ensure application standards and deployment requirements are met throughout the modernization effort.

title: Engenheiro(a) de Software Backend - Pleno (Golang)
description:
O seu papel como Software Engineer Pleno (E2)

  • Desenvolver programação do início ao fim, incluindo definições de arquitetura, testes e rollout em produção;
  • Desenvolvimento de projetos com arquitetura de microserviços, consumo e geração de eventos em Streaming, API's;
  • Garantir a funcionalidade, manutenibilidade e velocidade, além de práticas de teste e qualidade;

  • Continuous Delivery.

title: Mendix Developer Senior | LowCode
description:
Modelo de trabalho: 100% remoto


Sobre a vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Sênior – Mendix para liderar projetos estratégicos e ser referência técnica no time. Se você tem carreira sólida em tecnologia, experiência mínima de 2 anos com Mendix e gosta de compartilhar conhecimento, essa oportunidade é para você!

  • Desenvolver e evoluir aplicações Mendix, garantindo qualidade e integração.

  • Experiência mínima de 2 anos com Mendix .
  • Conhecimento em integração via APIs , modelagem de dados e versionamento (Git).

  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com arquitetura escalável , microsserviços e mensageria.

  • Base sólida em Java, JavaScript e princípios S.O.L.I.D.

Você fará parte de equipes diversas e de alto performance, em um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo. Valorizamos a contribuição de todos na criação de soluções e nas decisões estratégicas. Aqui, as pessoas são o nosso diferencial, e somos apaixonados por tecnologia, inovação e evolução contínua.

title: Consultor SAP SRM/MM
description:
A Atos é líder global em transformação digital, com 112 mil colaboradores em 73 países e receita anual de €12 bilhões. Há mais de 30 anos no Brasil conectando pessoas, negócios e tecnologia para ajudar a melhorar o mundo em que vivemos.


Sobre a Vaga

Buscamos uma Pessoa Consultora SAP SRM/MM para atuar em projetos e sustentação, com foco em processos de compras, melhorias contínuas e atendimento de chamados. A atuação será em ambiente remoto, com desafios técnicos e funcionais em um contexto corporativo.


Modelo de Trabalho: Home Office

Contratação: CLT

Prazo: Indeterminado

Horário: Comercial


Responsabilidades:

  • Atuar no suporte e atendimento de chamados relacionados aos módulos SAP SRM e SAP MM .
  • Realizar configurações (customizing) de acordo com os processos de negócio.
  • Trabalhar com gestão de contratos, cotações e pedidos de compra .
  • Desenvolver e implementar melhorias funcionais e técnicas .
  • Realizar dimensionamento de esforço para demandas e projetos.
  • Atuar com WEBDYNPRO , WORKFLOW de aprovação e ABAP para DEBUG quando necessário.
  • Apoiar áreas de negócio na otimização de processos e soluções SAP.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada com SAP SRM .
  • Experiência comprovada com SAP MM .
  • Conhecimento de processos de compras: gestão de contratos, cotações e pedidos de compra .
  • Experiência com configurações nos módulos.
  • Atuação com atendimento de chamados e implementação de melhorias .
  • Conhecimento funcional em WEBDYNPRO .
  • Conhecimento em WORKFLOW de aprovação .
  • Conhecimento em ABAP para DEBUG .
  • Graduação completa .


Diferencial:

  • Conhecimento em RM .


O que oferecemos:


✓ Vale refeição ou Vale alimentação

✓ Plano de saúde extensível a cônjuge e filhos

✓ Plano odontológico

✓ Programa de remuneração variável

✓ Auxílio creche - conforme regras sindicais da localidade

✓ Wellhub (Gympass)

✓ Convênio com farmácias – descontos em medicamentos

✓ Previdência Privada com seguro de vida adicional

✓ Seguro de vida

✓ Empréstimo Consignado (após 1 ano de empresa)

✓ Convênio com empresas parceiras (Descontos para realização de graduação, pós-graduação, MBA e Idiomas)

✓ Política de Subsídios para Pós-graduação, MBAs e Certificações (A Atos apoia o seu desenvolvimento, subsidiando financeiramente ações externas)

✓ Speexx (curso online de até 5 idiomas gratuitamente)

✓ Programa de treinamentos internos e externos

✓ Universidade corporativa (E-learning com milhares de cursos disponíveis gratuitamente)

✓ Terapia online

✓ Programa de acompanhamento à gestante (acompanhamento médico online durante a gestação para colaboradoras ou cônjuges)

✓ Programa Minha Nova Parceria de Confiança (para colaboradores e cônjuges. Válido também para filhos adotivos) - Brinde especial + Cartão presente com valor em dinheiro

✓ Day off no seu aniversário

✓ Parceria com a Samsung (descontos na compra de diversos produtos)

✓ Bônus de indicação para nossas vagas (conforme política interna)

✓ Jubileu (premiação personalizada por tempo de empresa)

✓ Accolade (Programa de reconhecimento)


Entendemos a diversidade como um fator valioso. Por isso, independentemente da sua identidade ou expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, etnia, idade, deficiência, cidadania ou qualquer outro aspecto que o torne único, inscreva-se!

title: Desenvolvedor SAP ABAP Fiori
description:
Desenvolvedor Sênior ABAP / Fiori

Local: 100% remoto

Regime: PJ ou Coop

Nível: Sênior


Sobre a posição

Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Sênior ABAP / Fiori para atuar em projetos estratégicos de modernização e evolução tecnológica no ecossistema SAP S/4HANA e SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform) .

O profissional será responsável por desenvolver soluções modernas utilizando ABAP Cloud e RAP (Restful ABAP Programming Model) integradas a SAP Fiori / UI5 , aplicando boas práticas de clean core e arquitetura extensível.

Além das iniciativas mais modernas, é importante que o profissional possua base sólida em ABAP Clássico , garantindo flexibilidade para atuar em demandas tradicionais quando necessário.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver aplicações e extensões com ABAP Cloud / RAP integradas a SAP Fiori / UI5 .
  • Implementar e manter serviços OData, CDS Views e AMDPs para consumo em interfaces Fiori.
  • Trabalhar em ambiente SAP S/4HANA e SAP BTP , aplicando conceitos de clean core e extensibilidade .
  • Apoiar arquitetos e consultores funcionais na definição e entrega de soluções técnicas.
  • Garantir performance, segurança e qualidade de código nas entregas.
  • Contribuir com revisões de código, boas práticas e mentoria técnica para o time.
  • Atuar também, quando necessário, em demandas ABAP Clássico , mantendo soluções legadas e promovendo sua evolução gradativa para o novo modelo.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • 5+ anos de experiência em desenvolvimento ABAP , com domínio de ABAP Clássico e ABAP Cloud .
  • Experiência sólida com RAP (Restful ABAP Programming Model) .
  • Domínio de SAP Fiori / SAP UI5 e Fiori Elements .
  • Conhecimento em CDS Views , OData Services , AMDPs e integrações RESTful .
  • Experiência com SAP S/4HANA e ferramentas modernas de desenvolvimento (Eclipse ADT, Git, transportes em BTP ).
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação e trabalho colaborativo em times ágeis.


Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento em CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model) .
  • Experiência com SAP BTP , extensões side-by-side e integrações em nuvem.
  • Certificação SAP ABAP for Cloud ou SAP BTP.
  • Experiência em S/4HANA Cloud (Public ou Private Edition) .

title: API Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for API Designer/Engineer who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Overview

The API Designer/Engineer is a pivotal role responsible for implementing API Design First principles to create scalable, secure, and consumer-centric APIs. The candidate will focus on designing API specifications and frameworks that ensure seamless developer experiences while meeting Customer's API standards and architectural guidelines.


Key Responsibilities

API Design & Development

  • Adopt an API Design First Approach : Leverage OpenAPI (Swagger), RAML, or AsyncAPI specifications to define APIs before implementation, ensuring clarity and alignment across stakeholders.
  • API Specification Creation : Design API specifications that adhere to Customer's API standards, covering endpoints, data structures, error handling, and response codes.
  • Policy Design and Configuration : Define and configure API policies (security, routing, transformation, throttling, etc.) using tools such as Azure API Management (APIM).
  • Mock API Development : Create mock APIs for early-stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development.
  • API Testing : Perform unit testing of API specifications to ensure functionality, reliability, and adherence to defined standards.
  • Environment Configuration : Configure API backend settings within APIM (naming conventions, App Insights, Key Vault) in DEV, UAT, and PRD environments.
  • API Deployment : Deploy draft APIs into the Azure APIM Dev instance and promote them across DEV, UAT, and PRD environments using the API DevOps framework.
  • Documentation : Create comprehensive API documentation, including references, developer guides, and examples, in line with Customer's standards.
  • Metadata Publishing : Publish API Identity Cards (metadata, usage information) to the Azure API Management Developer Portal to enable easy discovery and adoption by consumers.


API Consumer Onboarding

  • Secure Authentication Setup : Configure OAuth/OpenID Connect to ensure secure authentication and authorization for API consumers.
  • Subscription Key Management : Share API subscription keys securely with consumers and maintain robust tracking mechanisms.
  • Integration Testing Support : Collaborate with API consumers during integration testing to resolve issues and provide guidance on proper usage.


Testing & Validation

  • Functional Testing : Conduct and support API functional, integration, and performance testing to validate API readiness and scalability.
  • Mock and Staging Environment Management : Ensure availability of mock services and staging environments for API testing and feedback gathering.


Skills and Expertise

  • API Design First Expertise : Proficient in designing APIs using OpenAPI, SwaggerHub, or similar tools with a focus on consumer-first design principles.
  • Azure API Management : Deep experience in configuring and managing APIs using Azure API Management.
  • Security Standards : Strong knowledge of OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and API key management best practices.
  • Documentation Excellence : Skilled in creating developer-friendly documentation and API identity cards.
  • Testing Proficiency : Familiarity with API testing frameworks and methodologies to validate functionality and performance. Proficient in using Postman tool


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!


#Buildingonbelief

title: API Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for API Designer/Engineer who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Overview

The API Designer/Engineer is a pivotal role responsible for implementing API Design First principles to create scalable, secure, and consumer-centric APIs. The candidate will focus on designing API specifications and frameworks that ensure seamless developer experiences while meeting Customer's API standards and architectural guidelines.


Key Responsibilities

API Design & Development

  • Adopt an API Design First Approach : Leverage OpenAPI (Swagger), RAML, or AsyncAPI specifications to define APIs before implementation, ensuring clarity and alignment across stakeholders.
  • API Specification Creation : Design API specifications that adhere to Customer's API standards, covering endpoints, data structures, error handling, and response codes.
  • Policy Design and Configuration : Define and configure API policies (security, routing, transformation, throttling, etc.) using tools such as Azure API Management (APIM).
  • Mock API Development : Create mock APIs for early-stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development.
  • API Testing : Perform unit testing of API specifications to ensure functionality, reliability, and adherence to defined standards.
  • Environment Configuration : Configure API backend settings within APIM (naming conventions, App Insights, Key Vault) in DEV, UAT, and PRD environments.
  • API Deployment : Deploy draft APIs into the Azure APIM Dev instance and promote them across DEV, UAT, and PRD environments using the API DevOps framework.
  • Documentation : Create comprehensive API documentation, including references, developer guides, and examples, in line with Customer's standards.
  • Metadata Publishing : Publish API Identity Cards (metadata, usage information) to the Azure API Management Developer Portal to enable easy discovery and adoption by consumers.


API Consumer Onboarding

  • Secure Authentication Setup : Configure OAuth/OpenID Connect to ensure secure authentication and authorization for API consumers.
  • Subscription Key Management : Share API subscription keys securely with consumers and maintain robust tracking mechanisms.
  • Integration Testing Support : Collaborate with API consumers during integration testing to resolve issues and provide guidance on proper usage.


Testing & Validation

  • Functional Testing : Conduct and support API functional, integration, and performance testing to validate API readiness and scalability.
  • Mock and Staging Environment Management : Ensure availability of mock services and staging environments for API testing and feedback gathering.


Skills and Expertise

  • API Design First Expertise : Proficient in designing APIs using OpenAPI, SwaggerHub, or similar tools with a focus on consumer-first design principles.
  • Azure API Management : Deep experience in configuring and managing APIs using Azure API Management.
  • Security Standards : Strong knowledge of OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and API key management best practices.
  • Documentation Excellence : Skilled in creating developer-friendly documentation and API identity cards.
  • Testing Proficiency : Familiarity with API testing frameworks and methodologies to validate functionality and performance. Proficient in using Postman tool


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

title: Desenvolvedor Backend Sênior (.NET / C#)
description:
Desenvolvedor Backend Sênior (.NET / C#)

Modelo: Remoto

Sobre o desafio Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Sênior para atuar em uma squad estratégica responsável por sistemas críticos de pricing, políticas comerciais, descontos escalonados, contas correntes financeiras, conciliações e integrações corporativas. Você irá trabalhar em um ambiente de alta complexidade, alto volume transacional, forte governança, requisitos de auditoria e integrações distribuídas, suportando múltiplos canais digitais B2B (e-commerce, chatbot, APIs, EDI) e sistemas corporativos como SAP, ServiceNow, motores externos de cálculo e plataformas de dados. O papel exige forte capacidade de engenharia, visão sistêmica, responsabilidade técnica e maturidade para operar em ambiente regulado, com foco em performance, resiliência, observabilidade e escalabilidade. Responsabilidades

Desenvolver e evoluir APIs e serviços backend em C# (.NET) para sistemas de pricing, regras comerciais, incentivos, contas correntes e conciliações financeiras.

Atuar no desenho de arquiteturas cloud-native, orientadas a eventos e microsserviços, garantindo escalabilidade, disponibilidade e tolerância a falhas.

Implementar soluções com foco em: o Alta performance e baixa latência o Idempotência, versionamento, snapshots e rastreabilidade o Consistência de dados e integridade transacional o Observabilidade (logs, métricas, tracing distribuído)

Integrar sistemas internos e externos (ex: SAP, plataformas de parceiros, motores de cálculo, mensageria, APIs públicas e privadas).

Trabalhar com bancos relacionais e modelagem de dados complexa (PostgreSQL / SQL Server), incluindo otimização de queries e estratégia de índices.

Garantir padrões de qualidade: o Testes automatizados o Code review o Clean Architecture / SOLID o Segurança e compliance

Atuar em conjunto com Produto, Arquitetura, QA, DevOps e áreas de negócio, participando ativamente de refinamentos técnicos e tomada de decisão.

Apoiar tecnicamente desenvolvedores mais juniores, elevando o nível do time (mentoria técnica).


Requisitos Técnicos Obrigatórios

Experiência sólida como Desenvolvedor Backend Sênior com C# e .NET (.NET Core / .NET 8 e 10) Domínio de: o APIs REST o Microsserviços o Arquitetura em camadas / Clean Architecture o Design Patterns

Experiência comprovada com: o Sistemas de alta performance e alto volume o Processamento assíncrono o Mensageria (SQS e SNS) o Controle de concorrência

Experiência com bancos relacionais: o PostgreSQL e SQL Server o Modelagem relacional complexa o Otimização de queries e performance

Experiência em ambientes cloud AWS o Containers o Observabilidade o Monitoramento o Escalabilidade

Práticas de engenharia: o Testes automatizados o Versionamento (Git) o Code review Diferenciais (Nice to Have)

Experiência com: o Sistemas financeiros, pricing, billing, conciliação, ledger, marketplaces ou e-commerce B2B. o Arquitetura orientada a eventos. o Processamento batch e streaming. o Feature toggles, blue-green deploy, canary release.

Conhecimento em: o Domain-Driven Design (DDD) o Event Sourcing / CQRS o Observabilidade avançada (Datadog, OpenTelemetry).

Vivência em ambientes regulados, auditáveis ou com forte governança. Experiência integrando com ERPs (SAP ou similares).

title: Talent Matcher - Non Code
description:
About the Role


We are seeking an experienced Talent Manager to lead end-to-end recruitment delivery for customer-side non-technical roles at Turing. This role focuses on high-volume talent sourcing, capacity planning, and fulfillment across multiple client requirements in a fast-paced, remote environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Manage end-to-end hiring for multiple customer-side non-technical roles (3–4 concurrent requirements).
  • Serve as the primary point of contact between Delivery and Talent Fulfillment teams.
  • Assess talent supply, identify gaps, and activate external sourcing channels as needed.
  • Oversee capacity planning and hiring ramp-ups to meet client timelines.
  • Partner with Delivery Leads to align on requirements and expectations.
  • Track and report key hiring metrics, ensuring data accuracy and visibility.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 5–10 years of experience in recruitment delivery, talent operations, or global staffing.
  • Strong expertise in high-volume sourcing, pipeline management, and onboarding.
  • Experience with client-side hiring models and stakeholder management.
  • Data-driven, highly organized, and comfortable working in a remote, fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace tools (Sheets, Docs, Drive).


Preferred Experience

  • Data Annotation or marketplace-based hiring experience, including high-volume talent sourcing and onboarding.
  • Exposure to capacity planning tools or hiring dashboards.
  • Experience in high-growth or startup environments.


Soft Skills

  • Strong stakeholder communication and collaboration skills.
  • Analytical mindset with attention to detail.
  • Adaptability — thrives in ambiguity and rapidly changing environments.
  • Proactive problem solver with a focus on ownership over hierarchy.
  • Comfortable handling multiple priorities and working under tight timelines.


Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a hands-on operator who thrives at the intersection of talent fulfilment, data-driven decision-making, and stakeholder management. They should be proactive, outcome-oriented, and capable of maintaining operational excellence in a remote-first, high-speed environment.

title: Talent Matcher - Non Code
description:
About the Role


We are seeking an experienced Talent Manager to lead end-to-end recruitment delivery for customer-side non-technical roles at Turing. This role focuses on high-volume talent sourcing, capacity planning, and fulfillment across multiple client requirements in a fast-paced, remote environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Manage end-to-end hiring for multiple customer-side non-technical roles (3–4 concurrent requirements).
  • Serve as the primary point of contact between Delivery and Talent Fulfillment teams.
  • Assess talent supply, identify gaps, and activate external sourcing channels as needed.
  • Oversee capacity planning and hiring ramp-ups to meet client timelines.
  • Partner with Delivery Leads to align on requirements and expectations.
  • Track and report key hiring metrics, ensuring data accuracy and visibility.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 5–10 years of experience in recruitment delivery, talent operations, or global staffing.
  • Strong expertise in high-volume sourcing, pipeline management, and onboarding.
  • Experience with client-side hiring models and stakeholder management.
  • Data-driven, highly organized, and comfortable working in a remote, fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace tools (Sheets, Docs, Drive).


Preferred Experience

  • Data Annotation or marketplace-based hiring experience, including high-volume talent sourcing and onboarding.
  • Exposure to capacity planning tools or hiring dashboards.
  • Experience in high-growth or startup environments.


Soft Skills

  • Strong stakeholder communication and collaboration skills.
  • Analytical mindset with attention to detail.
  • Adaptability — thrives in ambiguity and rapidly changing environments.
  • Proactive problem solver with a focus on ownership over hierarchy.
  • Comfortable handling multiple priorities and working under tight timelines.


Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a hands-on operator who thrives at the intersection of talent fulfilment, data-driven decision-making, and stakeholder management. They should be proactive, outcome-oriented, and capable of maintaining operational excellence in a remote-first, high-speed environment.

title: Desenvolvedor Java
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!

Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!

Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Responsabilidades:

Definir e priorizar o backlog do produto, garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos estratégicos da empresa;

Traduzir necessidades de negócio em requisitos claros e detalhados para a equipe de desenvolvimento;

Conduzir reuniões de refinamento e planejamento com stakeholders e times ágeis;

Garantir que as entregas atendam aos critérios de aceite e gerem valor para o usuário final;

Acompanhar métricas de performance do produto e propor melhorias contínuas;

Trabalhar em colaboração com áreas como UX/UI, engenharia, marketing e operações para garantir o sucesso do produto;

Facilitar a comunicação entre as áreas de negócio e tecnologia, garantindo alinhamento estratégico;

Conduzir benchmarkings e pesquisas para identificar tendências e oportunidades de inovação.


Responsabilidades

  • Atuar no processo de desenvolvimento de software de sistemas da área
  • Propor e desenvolver soluções inovadoras que garantam resiliência e escalabilidade
  • Participar de refinamentos e cerimônias ágeis
  • Acompanhar todo o ciclo de vida da plataforma, interagindo com outras áreas técnicas e de negócio
  • Atuar como facilitador técnico na equipe, orientando e propagando conhecimento quando necessário

Conhecimentos Técnicos

  • Java JDK 17+ (desejável experiência com Java JDK 17)
  • Java 8 ou superior
  • Spring Boot
  • Banco de dados relacionais
  • Kubernetes
  • Spring Framework e Spring Batch
  • Metodologias ágeis (Kanban, Scrum e Jira)
  • Versionamento e CI/CD
  • Arquitetura de microserviços e design patterns
  • GitLab
  • Soluções cloud (GCP)



Formato de trabalho: Home office


E temos também o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!
