title: Data Analyst (Azure)
description:
About You

You are a data-driven professional who enjoys transforming complex data into clear, actionable insights that drive business decisions. You thrive in client-facing environments, work comfortably with ambiguity, and take ownership of turning business questions into meaningful metrics, dashboards, and recommendations. You value data quality, storytelling, and collaboration with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.


You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related field.
  • 4–5 years of hands-on experience in data analysis, reporting, and business intelligence roles.
  • Strong experience with Power BI for data visualization, dashboard design, and reporting.
  • Proficiency in Python for data manipulation and analysis.
  • Advanced knowledge of SQL , including complex queries, stored procedures, and performance optimization.
  • Experience working with Azure and cloud-based data solutions.
  • Ability to translate data into business-oriented insights, narratives, and recommendations.
  • Experience collaborating with stakeholders in fast-paced, client-facing environments.
  • Understanding of software development best practices and exposure to modern data platforms.
  • Excellent English communication skills, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Gather and analyze business requirements to define KPIs, metrics, and reporting needs.
  • Design, develop, and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports that deliver clear and actionable insights.
  • Collect and integrate data from multiple sources (databases, APIs, files, streams) into analysis-ready datasets.
  • Clean, validate, and prepare data by resolving inconsistencies, errors, and missing values.
  • Apply statistical and analytical techniques to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to support strategic and operational decision-making.
  • Support predictive analysis and forecasting initiatives using statistical and machine learning techniques.
  • Ensure data quality, governance, and security standards are consistently met.
  • Communicate findings effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders through reports and presentations.


Qualifications

Tableau, Power BI and Qlik


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.


Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*


*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to support strategic and operational decision-making.
  • Support predictive analysis and forecasting initiatives using statistical and machine learning techniques.
  • Ensure data quality, governance, and security standards are consistently met.
  • Communicate findings effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders through reports and presentations.

Tableau, Power BI and Qlik

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.


Some of our perks and benefits:

title: Analista de Projetos e Contratos de Obras Jr
description:
Sobre a vaga


Você quer participar da transformação do saneamento no Brasil? Buscamos pessoas que, assim como nós, têm vontade de ir além do básico para aplicar seus conhecimentos em um setor que está mudando a vida de milhões de brasileiros e brasileiras. Na BRK, respeito, diversidade e inclusão são valores inegociáveis! Atuamos para promover um ambiente positivo, inovador, ético, inclusivo, seguro e de respeito às pessoas.

Se você sempre quis trabalhar com propósito, temos uma oportunidade que pode te interessar:


Principais Responsabilidades:


  • Planejar, desenvolver e controlar projetos de investimentos e obras de infraestrutura, garantindo o avanço dos serviços de saneamento;
  • Realizar o controle físico-financeiro das obras, elaborando orçamentos, termos de referência, analisando relatórios e propondo soluções para aumento da eficiência dos projetos;
  • Acompanhar a execução das obras, desde a análise da documentação da empresa prestadora de serviços;
  • Avaliar tecnicamente a aquisição de materiais, equipamentos e serviços;
  • Elaborar relatórios e apresentações, acompanhando indicadores de desempenho;
  • Realizar o acompanhamento das obras nas unidades de Porto Ferreira e Sumaré.


Requisitos:


  • Ensino Superior completo ou cursando em Engenharia Civil, Ambiental ou Sanitária;
  • Conhecimento intermediário no Pacote Office;
  • CNH categoria B;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em Sumaré/SP.


O que oferecemos:


Assistência Médica e Odontológica, Vale Refeição ou Alimentação, Seguro de Vida, Previdência Privada, Vale Transporte, Programa de Apoio à Saúde, Gympass, DayOff, Licença Maternidade ou Paternidade estendida, PLR; + Algumas vantagens que você pode conhecer durante o processo.


A BRK é uma das maiores empresas privadas de saneamento do país e está presente em 13 estados e mais de 100 municípios, beneficiando a vida de mais de 16 milhões de pessoas. Investimos e operamos sistemas de água e esgoto, fornecendo um serviço que faz toda a diferença para a saúde e o bem-estar da população.


A BRK e seus acionistas estão comprometidos com um modelo de gestão ESG (da sigla em inglês para Meio Ambiente, Social e Governança), incorporando esta estratégia à tomada de decisões da companhia e à prestação de serviços.


Este é o nosso jeito de contribuir para o desenvolvimento das comunidades onde atuamos e de transformar a vida de milhões de pessoas levando o saneamento para muito além do básico!

VEM SER BRK!

title: Analista Atração e Seleção PL (Vaga Afirmativa PCD)
description:
O Grupo Petrópolis é a única grande empresa do setor cervejeiro com capital 100% nacional. Produz as marcas de cerveja Itaipava, Cabaré, Crystal, Lokal, Black Princess, Petra e Weltenburger, Brassaria Ampolis com os rótulos Cacildis, Biritis, Ditriguis e Forévis, as vodkas Blue Spirit Ice e Nordka, a Cabaré Ice, os energéticos TNT Energy Drink e Magneto, o refrigerante It!, o isotônico TNT Sports Drink e a água Petra. Com oito fábricas em operação e aproximadamente 132 centros de distribuição, o grupo é responsável pela geração de aproximadamente 22 mil empregos diretos. Por meio dos projetos ambientais, promove o plantio e manutenção de milhares de árvores, além de ações de sustentabilidade e programa de educação ambiental para escolas municipais. Conta também com o Saber Beber, programa comprometido em orientar as pessoas sobre os benefícios do consumo moderado e as consequências do consumo exagerado de álcool.

title: Supervisor(a) de Estúdio
description:
Vaga: Supervisor(a) de Estúdio

Local: Escritório Pinheiros – São Paulo/SP | Modelo: 100% Presencial

Nível: Sênior


Chegou a sua hora de liderar a operação que transforma produto em imagem de alta performance!

No e-commerce da Centauro, o estúdio é um pilar estratégico da experiência do cliente. Cada foto e vídeo precisa traduzir qualidade, consistência visual e agilidade, respeitando o Style Guide da marca e os prazos do varejo.

Buscamos um(a) Supervisor(a) de Estúdio para atuar como guardião da eficiência operacional e da excelência técnica, liderando o ciclo completo da produção visual — do planejamento dos calendários à entrega dos resultados — com foco em qualidade, dados e escalabilidade.


Seus desafios no jogo:

  • Atuar como aprovador(a) final da produção técnica e estética de fotos e vídeos, garantindo consistência de luz, cor, enquadramento e styling;
  • Manter e evoluir o Style Guide e os manuais de luz, assegurando padronização e identidade visual da marca;
  • Analisar causas de refações e rejeições, implementando melhorias imediatas nos processos e no set;
  • Planejar e gerenciar o calendário de shootings, coordenando prazos entre modelos, freelancers e times internos;
  • Gerir o fluxo completo das peças no estúdio, desde o recebimento até a entrega final para o e-commerce;
  • Liderar o time técnico (fotografia, vídeo, styling e edição), garantindo produtividade e cumprimento de SLAs;
  • Elaborar e apresentar relatórios de produtividade, custos e qualidade para a liderança e diretoria.


Esperamos que você tenha:

  • Superior completo em Fotografia, Publicidade e Propaganda, Moda, Design, Comunicação, Administração, Produção Audiovisual ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida na liderança de estúdios de moda ou e-commerce de alto volume;
  • Domínio do fluxo de produção visual ponta a ponta (planejamento, captura, edição e entrega);
  • Olhar crítico e técnico para auditoria de qualidade de imagem e vídeo;
  • Forte capacidade de organização, gestão de cronogramas e tomada de decisão sob pressão;
  • Perfil analítico, com facilidade para transformar operação em dados e KPIs;
  • Boa comunicação para interação com times internos, parceiros externos e liderança.


Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de fluxo e estúdio (Creative Force, ShotFlow, Monday, Airtable ou similares);
  • Vivência em operações de e-commerce de grande escala e alta cadência de produção;
  • Conhecimento em controle de custos e otimização financeira (custo por SKU, refação, horas extras);
  • Noções de pós-produção para melhor integração com o time de edição;
  • Experiência na gestão de freelancers, casting e fornecedores audiovisuais.


O que você encontra por aqui:

  • Atuação em uma operação de estúdio estratégica e de alto impacto no e-commerce;
  • Interface direta com áreas de E-commerce, Produto, Comercial e Diretoria;
  • Ambiente dinâmico, colaborativo e orientado a dados e resultados;
  • Autonomia para implementar melhorias de processo, qualidade e produtividade;
  • Oportunidade de liderar e escalar uma operação visual em constante evolução.

title: Wordpress Plugin & Full Stack Developer
description:
Please only apply if you are familiar with Wordpress Plugin Development, with strong PHP skills in additional to being a full stack (front and back) developer. Ideally you should also be comfortable with mobile apps and figuring out and doing different things in tech and thrive in a fast-paced fluid environment.


Do you love technology puzzles and figuring out how to make a variety of things to work? Are you great at catching mistakes through user testing for quality assurance? Are you a dedicated, resourceful team player with strong problem solving skills? Do you have experience working with numerous different technology platforms in digital form, ranging from CRMs (like Constant Contact, Aweber, Beehiiv), Hosting (AWS, WHM), DNS (Cloudflare), Automtions (like zapier, make.com), project management (like jira.com)?


Detail oriented test and php / elementor test REQUIRED before video interview.


About Us

Life Water Media specializes in digital branding and awareness campaigns for publicly traded companies in the United States stock market and other large scale projects. We started in 2019. We internally own 10 newsletter brands, a mobile app, and other digital assets.


Responsibilities

  • Focus on building out custom wordpress plugins for internal agency needs
  • Focus on connecting marketing data for purposes of analysis, can range from open rates in crm, to costs on paid media platforms, to click through data on sms provider.
  • Setting up CRM lists, automations, and funnels from start to finish with script, reporting and directly on the platforms.
  • Willing to have a flexible set of responsibilities to service whatever is required in daily operations, including posting daily new article first thing in the mornings.
  • Work hand-in-hand with CTO and CMO on various directives. If you see a way to do it better, we'd love to hear it.
  • Handle multiple projects from start to finish, adhering to set deadlines set by CTO or CMO.
  • Doing or setting up manual/automated reporting related to adspend, subscriber counts, open rates, cost per lead, etc
  • Copying, testing, and fixing Elementor landing pages and ensuring they are properly connected to CRM, SMS, webhooks, etc.
  • Copying, testing, fixing PHP scripts ensuring they are properly connected to CRM, SMS provider, webhooks, postbacks, etc.
  • On CRM set up lists/segments, automations for the welcome emails, templates, list cleaning,
  • Doing specific weekly and monthly audits of our 10 newsletter landing page and script funnels.
  • Testing and helping manage our mobile app.

title: Senior Software Developer - React Native
description:
Project Description:

Our Client is one of largest TV providers in North America and we are searching for a Senior Software Developer to join our team. The project focuses on developing mobile application for video streaming platform.


Responsibilities:

You will be implementing new features and enhancing existing functionalities on client applications to support streaming video products. This includes estimation, design, development, testing, and documentation.

Collaborate with other software engineers, product managers, and architects in a cross functional environment to ensure functions and performance meet customer requirements in a cost effective and maintainable way.

Provide on-call support including monitoring, triaging and resolving production issues


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • - Proficient in JavaScript and React Native mobile app development (5+ years) as well as at least one of the following: Java/Kotlin or Obj-C/Swift
  • - Streaming mobile app development experience with iOS/Android and TV Platforms
  • - Strong teamwork focus and the ability to foster collaboration within and across teams
  • - Experience with agile development
  • - Good verbal/written communications skills


Languages:

  • English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Project Description:

We are looking for passionate and creative developers eager to craft innovative products and embrace new technologies. You will be part of a small, agile, and highly skilled team of technologists who are building next generation of solutions for Risk Management team and Portfolio Managers.


To thrive in our team, you should possess an independent mindset while enjoying a collaborative working environment. We value candidates with full software lifecycle experience, encompassing requirements gathering, implementation, testing, release, and ongoing support.


Responsibilities:

  • Minimum 5 years of backend development experience, preferably within the hedge fund or financial services industry
  • Strong passion for backend architecture and application development, with a commitment to continuous learning and improvement
  • Deep understanding of Object-Oriented Programming, SOLID principles, and design patterns
  • Excellent communication skills and a collaborative mindset


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • C#, ASP.NET Core, .NET Core, Entity Framework Core
  • Building and optimizing high-load, high-performance, data-driven backend systems
  • Designing and implementing RESTful and SOAP-based web services
  • Experience with Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA)


Languages:

  • English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: Meitu Campus Ambassador (Design Track)
description:
Remote Work, Part-time, Internship


We’re looking for someone with a sharp eye for aesthetics who can catch the hottest visual styles on campus and help our products look and feel right for local users.


What You’ll Do:

● Capture Visual Trends: Continuously analyze the aesthetic preferences and popular styles among local students to guide product design.

● Localize Visuals: Help adjust marketing materials visually (like layout and cultural fit) and create visuals that align with local aesthetics.

● Be a design critic: Review our products (and competitors') from a user’s perspective identify visual or experience flaws, and give practical feedback.


We Hope You Are:

● Have a keen eye: naturally notice design, imagery, and visual trends in everyday life and social media; are interested in youth culture and what’s trending locally.

● Think like a visual detective: not just see if something looks good—but ask why it’s designed in that way and how it could be better.

● Care about user experience: pay attention to how visuals affect usability and enjoy comparing product designs critically.


Bonus Points If You Have:

● Extensive knowledge of local visual product usage habits gained from living in regions like North America, Latam America, or East/Southeast Asia.

● A background in design, art, visual communication, or digital media arts.

● Have hands-on experience in graphic design, UI/UX, video editing, or photography.

● Are part of design clubs, competitions, or create visual content yourself.


What You’ll Get:

Co-creation & Growth

● Early access to product features and training sessions

● Workshops on social media, product, or design


Rewards & Credit System

We’ll regularly post tasks with different credit values. Pick what interests you, complete tasks to earn credits and base pay. With an exceptional peformance, you will earn bonus creditws!

Redeem credits for:

● Annual Meitu VIP membership

● “Meitu Elite Campus Ambassador” Certificate + internship reference

● Meitu Special Deisgn

● Exclusive chats with Meitu experts/executive leadership

● Summer Internship Offer

● Greenlight for graduate hires interview (skip some interview rounds and get priority hiring after graduation)


About Meitu

Founded in 2008, Meitu is an AI-driven technology company that regards \"beauty\" as its core ideal. Guided by our mission to \"Uniting Art and Technology\", Meitu is committed to creating world-class imaging products that simplify the creation of images, videos, designs, and other visual content.


Meitu was listed in 2016 on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange(stock code 1357.HK). As of June 30, 2025, Meitu had 280 million global monthly active users, including 98 million from regions and countries outside Mainland China.


We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, disability, or veteran status.


At Meitu, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Sonata Software Overview

In today's market, there is a unique duality in technology adoption. On one side, extreme focus on cost containment by clients, and on the other, deep motivation to modernize their Digital storefronts to attract more consumers and B2B customers.

As a leading Modernization Engineering company, we aim to deliver modernization-driven hypergrowth for our clients based on the deep differentiation we have created in Modernization Engineering, powered by our Lightening suite and 16-step Platformation™ playbook. In addition, we bring agility and systems thinking to accelerate time to market for our clients.

Headquartered in Bengaluru, India, Sonata has a strong global presence, including key regions in the US, UK, Europe, APAC, and ANZ. We are a trusted partner of world-leading companies in BFSI (Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance), HLS (Healthcare and Lifesciences), TMT (Telecom, Media, and Technology), Retail & CPG, and Manufacturing space. Our bouquet of Modernization Engineering Services cuts across Cloud, Data, Dynamics, Contact Centres, and around newer technologies like Generative AI, MS Fabric, and other modernization platforms.



Job Title: Site Reliability Operations

Location: Brazil (Remote)



Ideal Experience:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or comparable experience.
  • Advanced AWS Certifications strongly preferred
  • 3–5+ years of experience working in both Windows and Linux environments, with demonstrated success in advanced troubleshooting and administration.
  • Proven proficiency in monitoring and alerting tools such as Nagios, New Relic, SumoLogic, AWS CloudWatch, and related technologies.
  • Strong scripting or programming skills in PowerShell, Python, or a similar language; ability to automate repetitive tasks and streamline operations.
  • Excellent organizational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and urgent issues in a fast-paced setting.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to explain complex technical issues to stakeholders at various technical levels.
  • Comfortable completing annual role-based training and certification assignments; dedicated to continual learning and development.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently on complex tasks and to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.




Why join Sonata Software?

At Sonata, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build never seen before solutions to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you will not be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

Sonata Software is an Equal Opportunity Employer encouraging diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, gender identity, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristics protected by law.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Sonata Software Overview

In today's market, there is a unique duality in technology adoption. On one side, extreme focus on cost containment by clients, and on the other, deep motivation to modernize their Digital storefronts to attract more consumers and B2B customers.

As a leading Modernization Engineering company, we aim to deliver modernization-driven hypergrowth for our clients based on the deep differentiation we have created in Modernization Engineering, powered by our Lightening suite and 16-step Platformation™ playbook. In addition, we bring agility and systems thinking to accelerate time to market for our clients.

Headquartered in Bengaluru, India, Sonata has a strong global presence, including key regions in the US, UK, Europe, APAC, and ANZ. We are a trusted partner of world-leading companies in BFSI (Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance), HLS (Healthcare and Lifesciences), TMT (Telecom, Media, and Technology), Retail & CPG, and Manufacturing space. Our bouquet of Modernization Engineering Services cuts across Cloud, Data, Dynamics, Contact Centres, and around newer technologies like Generative AI, MS Fabric, and other modernization platforms.



Job Title: Site Reliability Operations

Location: Brazil (Remote)



Ideal Experience:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or comparable experience.
  • Advanced AWS Certifications strongly preferred
  • 3–5+ years of experience working in both Windows and Linux environments, with demonstrated success in advanced troubleshooting and administration.
  • Proven proficiency in monitoring and alerting tools such as Nagios, New Relic, SumoLogic, AWS CloudWatch, and related technologies.
  • Strong scripting or programming skills in PowerShell, Python, or a similar language; ability to automate repetitive tasks and streamline operations.
  • Excellent organizational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and urgent issues in a fast-paced setting.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to explain complex technical issues to stakeholders at various technical levels.
  • Comfortable completing annual role-based training and certification assignments; dedicated to continual learning and development.

title: Especialista em Business Intelligence (BI)
description:
Vaga: Especialista em Business Intelligence (BI)

Local : Home office, com 2 visitas anuais a Portugal

Contratação : Pessoa Jurídica (PJ)


Descrição da vaga:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Especialista em BI altamente qualificado(a) para atuar de forma consultiva no desenvolvimento de soluções analíticas voltadas à geração de valor para o negócio. O(a) profissional será responsável por interpretar dados, identificar oportunidades e entregar insights por meio de relatórios e dashboards interativos.

A posição é remota , com possibilidade de visitas pontuais a clientes. Procuramos alguém com domínio de Power BI , Pentaho , MS SQL Server , inglês fluente e forte visão de negócios .


Responsabilidades:

  • Construir dashboards e relatórios em Power BI com foco em performance e experiência do usuário.
  • Desenvolver e manter processos de ETL utilizando:

- Pentaho Data Integration (Kettle)

-Azure Data Factory

  • Conhecimento avançados em Databricks
  • Realizar extração, modelagem e análise de dados em Microsoft SQL Server .
  • Compreender os desafios das áreas de negócio e propor soluções baseadas em dados.
  • Participar de reuniões com clientes e stakeholders, inclusive em inglês .
  • Garantir a qualidade, consistência e integridade das informações entregues.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Experiência comprovada com Power BI , incluindo DAX, Power Query e modelagem de dados.
  • Conhecimento sólido em ETL nas plataformas Pentaho, Microsoft e AWS .
  • Domínio de MS SQL Server (consultas, modelagem, procedures).
  • Inglês fluente (escrita e conversação).
  • Boa visão de negócios , com capacidade de traduzir dados em soluções práticas.
  • Excelente comunicação, autonomia e postura consultiva.


Desejável:

  • Conhecimento em ambientes de nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP).
  • Familiaridade com Python, R ou outras linguagens para análise de dados.
  • Experiência com outras ferramentas de BI.
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis.


Informações adicionais:

  • Modalidade: PJ
  • Regime: Home office , com disponibilidade para visitas esporádicas a clientes
  • Projeto de médio a longo prazo
